raw.observed: burst1 p99: 637.70-904.74 ms (passes), aggregate (week scale) p99: 588.37-784.48 ms (passes), burst3 p99: 1,973.29-11,567.99 ms (fails) vs forecast burst3 p99: 588.37 ms
raw.claimed: passes burst1 & week scale, fails burst3 (p99 1,973-11,568 ms vs forecast's 588 ms) at the same rho=15
raw.evidence: The ablation runner script (run_ablation.sh) proves the react_p90_W* runs were executed at --rho 15; rho=NULL in runs/v_dim is a database-ingest parsing artifact for the rerun_verify experiment. Latency metrics match perfectly.
